receipt.public_excerpt: Reasoning obstacles exist in the forward reasoning of geometric structures.

evidence_items.explanation: The January report finds GPT-4o accuracy of 77.86% on basic and 47.93% on advanced text-based relationship tasks, and separately analyzes failed deductions in GPT-3.5-Turbo responses. This supports weaknesses in both components, but the strongest model approximately matches the advanced human baseline of 47.79%; the experiment dates are unspecified.

Gemini formalized 30 of 39 formalizable IMO problems using a multi-call prompting procedure, with strong reported performance on easier problems. This qualifies any sweeping interpretation of geometric incapacity, but formalization is a different task and the report falls outside the selected snapshot.

unresolved_gaps: The reasoning-error analysis centers on GPT-3.5-Turbo; it does not establish similarly substantial deduction failures in the stronger contemporary chatbot models.
GeomRel explicitly limits its scope to relationship identification rather than more complex reasoning.
The inspected sources do not establish exact experiment dates or fully cover the model versions available around the post.
The human comparison and successful basic-task performance limit what low advanced accuracy alone establishes about huge gaps.
